title: Wɔn a Wɔnwoo Wɔn Bɔhyɛ
intro: Ɔkra a ɔwɔ koma pa hyɛɛ bɔ kronkron ansa na abofra reba. Saa onipa yi asɛm no kɔ so wɔ kronkronbea bi afasu mu, baabi a ahofama hyia ɔsoro gye a wogye tom no. Hwan ne Allah akoa yi?
clues: Na meyɛ abusua bi a wɔhyɛ wɔn anuonyam wɔ Kur’aan mu no muni.
Mehyɛɛ bɔ a emu yɛ den sɛ mɛhyira me ba a ɔhyɛ yafunu mu no so ama Allah som.
Bere a mewoo no, ɛyɛɛ me nwonwa sɛ mihui sɛ ɛyɛ ɔbabea, ɛwom sɛ na mehwɛ kwan sɛ menya ɔbabarima de.
Metoo me ba no din Maryam, edin a ɛda ahofama ne ɔsom adi.
Mehwehwɛɛ Allah banbɔ maa me ba ne n’asefoɔ firii Satan a wɔadome no no nkyɛn.
Awurade gyee me ba no toom na ɔde no hyɛɛ Ɔkɔmhyɛni Zakariya hwɛ ase wɔ kronkronbea hɔ.

trial.label: Sɔhwɛ/Asɛm a esii
options: Ɔka ntam sɛ obehyira ne ba so ama asɔredan no
Po a wotwa wɔ asase kesee so
Mpataa kɛse bi a ɔbɛmene no
trial.answer: Ɔka ntam sɛ obehyira ne ba so ama asɔredan no

location.label: Ade Titiriw
options: Kronkronbea (mihrab) a wɔde ne ba no too hɔ
Date dua a ɔde gyee n’ahome wɔ ase no
location.answer: Kronkronbea (mihrab) a wɔde ne ba no too hɔ

outcome.label: Nsunsuansoɔ
options: Wɔgyee ne ba no toom na wɔde no too Ɔkɔmhyɛni Zakariya hwɛ ase
Wogyee no fii otirimɔdenfo asotwe mu
Wɔmaa no ɔbabarima a wɔfrɛ no Yahya
Ɔbɛyɛɛ ɔhemmaa wɔ ahenni kɛse bi so
outcome.answer: Wɔgyee ne ba no toom na wɔde no too Ɔkɔmhyɛni Zakariya hwɛ ase

arabic: إِذْ قَالَتِ ٱمْرَأَتُ عِمْرَٰنَ رَبِّ إِنِّى نَذَرْتُ لَكَ مَا فِى بَطْنِى مُحَرَّرًۭا فَتَقَبَّلْ مِنِّىٓ ۖ إِنَّكَ أَنتَ ٱلسَّمِيعُ ٱلْعَلِيمُ
verse: [Mention, O Muḥammad], when the wife of ʿImrān said, "My Lord, indeed I have pledged to You what is in my womb, consecrated [for Your service], so accept this from me. Indeed, You are the Hearing, the Knowing." (3:35)
